flux.title: Flux
flux.summary: A modern iOS finance app designed to make money management feel clear, fast and effortless — from everyday visibility to smarter financial decisions.
flux.overview: I created Flux from the ground up to explore how thoughtful product design and maintainable iOS architecture can simplify personal finance. The project brings together clear information hierarchy, smooth interactions and a focused experience that removes unnecessary complexity.
goals: Create a complete personal finance experience from the ground up
Practice maintainable architecture and clear separation of concerns
Design an intuitive and consistent interface for financial information
Handle loading, empty, success and error states reliably

focusAreas.title: Architecture
focusAreas.description: Modular responsibilities and MVVM patterns designed for maintainability and future growth.

focusAreas.title: User experience
focusAreas.description: A focused interface with clear hierarchy, purposeful motion and approachable financial information.

focusAreas.title: Reliability
focusAreas.description: Predictable state handling, persistence and defensive error treatment throughout the app.

features.title: Financial overview
features.description: A clear starting point for understanding balances, activity and financial progress.

features.title: Simple interactions
features.description: Focused flows that reduce friction and keep important actions easy to understand.

features.title: Persistent data
features.description: Local data management designed to keep the experience fast and dependable.
